badge.description: Optional badge text displayed above heading (e.g., 'Powered by Industry Leaders')

badgeIcon.description: Icon for badge. Use emoji (🚀) or Lucide icon name (Rocket, Star, Zap, TrendingUp, Award, CheckCircle, etc.)

badgeSize.description: Badge size: small (compact for nav/articles), medium (default balanced size), large (prominent for hero sections)

badgeAnimation.description: Enable orbiting light animation around badge border

badgeAnimationSpeed.description: Animation speed: extra-slow (10s), slow (5s), medium (3s), fast (1.5s)

badgeOrbSize.description: Size of the orbiting light: small (subtle), medium (balanced), large (prominent glow)

badgeBorderRadius.description: Badge border radius: sm (subtle rounded corners), md (medium rounded), lg (more rounded), full (pill-shaped)

badgeOrbGlow.description: Orb glow intensity: subtle (soft diffused glow), normal (balanced), intense (sharp bright glow)

heading.description: Main heading text. When using two-tone style, this is the second part (non-accented)

headingAccent.description: Accented part of heading for two-tone style. This text appears first in theme color. Leave empty for default/gradient styles.

backgroundStyle.description: Section background style: transparent (none), muted (subtle grey), theme-subtle (light theme gradient - great continuity with component borders), theme-muted (stronger theme color)

headingStyle.description: Heading text style: default (solid), gradient (subtle theme gradient), two-tone (first word accented)

containerStyle.description: Heading/description container style: default (no border), bordered (theme-colored border with gradient background - makes content stand out)
